comment: The window is built in src/Brink/dsp.h:137 as centre minus half the span to centre plus half the span, so WIDTH is the total span and not a distance from the midpoint. HYSTERESIS at src/Brink/dsp.h:12 is 0.001, applied to every boundary test in advance_region. The four boundary triggers last 0.001 seconds, set in start_pulse at src/Brink/dsp.h:215. The channel-A-to-B normalling is done by substituting the Input object itself rather than a voltage, so a polyphonic cable on Channel A carries across in full, and each of the three normals is broken independently by patching the matching Channel B jack. BrinkV2 includes ../Brink/dsp.h and repeats the same process() body, so the two models compute the same thing; only the faceplate differs, and BrinkV2 carries its lettering in the panel SVG.
